title: From Plan to Release | 2.5D Raid Simulator
author: Grokhnars
selftext:
Hello Folks,

  
im planning to start a rather huge open source project on github.

I'm using to claude accounts.

  
I’m building an open-source 2.5D Raid Simulator.

The goal: a modular raid system where encounters, bosses, abilities, characters and mechanics can be extended without rebuilding the entire game.

🎮 5-player parties  
🧠 Boss AI & mechanics  
⚔️ Abilities & combat systems  
🏰 Modular raid encounters  
🔧 Built with Unity  
🎨 Blender-based assets  
📖 Open source

This is just the beginning.



  
One of the main goals of my 2.5D Raid Simulator is **extensibility**.

I don't want every new boss or raid to require rewriting core systems.

Instead:

⚔️ Encounters are modular  
🧠 AI is system-based  
✨ Abilities are data-driven  
👥 Parties are configurable  
🏰 Raids can be expanded independently

Build the systems once. Create many encounters with them.

  
Everyone is welcome to contribute to the project
